full_prompt_en: A square pop-art illustration shows a dark-haired woman resting her face in both hands against a flat, brilliant yellow background. The yellow field fills every corner without scenery or visible texture, making the black shape of her hair and clothing immediately dominant. Her short, voluminous hair sweeps across the upper frame in thick black curves, broken by small strokes of dark blue and a slim red band near the crown. She faces forward with her elbows tucked inward and her pale palms pressed lightly to her cheeks. Wide blue-gray eyes look upward, framed by precise lashes and fine black brows; small dark marks define the nose and the contours beside her mouth. Her lips are painted saturated red, the strongest warm accent after the yellow ground. The bare face and forearms are creamy white with very little modeling, while the black top forms a broad curved mass across the lower portion. A slim dark wristband lies on one forearm. Hair strands, eyelids, fingers, and fabric boundaries are drawn with brisk irregular ink lines; the main color areas remain smooth and opaque. The image uses only a few colors, but variations in line weight give the expression energy and retain a hand-drawn quality. The lighting is even and graphic rather than naturalistic, with minimal cast shadow and dark regions defined mainly by solid ink. The overall composition is bold and close, balancing an expressive pale face between black curves and a high-impact yellow field.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形波普艺术插画，一位黑发女子以双手托住面颊，背后是平整而明亮的黄色背景。黄色色域填满所有角落，没有场景或可见纹理，使她的黑发和衣服立即成为主要形体。短而蓬松的头发在画面上方扫出厚实黑色曲线，间以少量深蓝笔触和靠近头顶的一道细红色发带。她正面朝向观者，双肘向内收，浅色手掌轻轻贴在脸颊上。宽大的蓝灰色眼睛向上看，周围有精确睫毛和纤细黑眉；小段深色刻痕界定鼻子与嘴旁轮廓。双唇涂成饱和红色，是黄色底色之外最强的暖色强调。露出的脸和前臂呈奶油白，塑形很少，黑色上衣则在下半部形成宽阔弯曲团块。一只细深色腕带绕在一侧前臂上。发丝、眼睑、手指和衣物边界用迅疾且略不规则的墨线描出；主要色域仍平滑不透明。画面只用少数几种颜色，但线条粗细变化赋予神情活力，也保留手绘质感。光线均匀且具有图形性，并非自然主义；投影极少，暗区主要由纯黑油墨界定。整体构图大胆而贴近，以黑色曲线和冲击力强的黄色色域夹住富于表情的浅色面部。
style_prompt_en: The image has a bold pop-art screenprint quality, with broad opaque fields of saturated primary color meeting dense black shapes. Creamy light areas are held almost flat, while swift irregular ink contours and changing line weight supply expression and movement. Small accents of cool blue and vivid red sharpen the contrast without complicating the limited palette. Edges are crisp at the scale of the main color blocks, but the drawn lines retain slight hand-made variation. Lighting is graphic and even, with shadow translated into solid dark masses rather than gradual tonal modeling. A close, cropped arrangement pushes the focal form toward the viewer and lets one uninterrupted color field work as strong negative space. The overall effect is bright, immediate, and theatrical.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有醒目的波普艺术丝网印刷质感，大块不透明饱和原色与浓密黑色形体相接。奶油色浅部几乎保持平面，迅疾而略不规则的墨线轮廓与变化线宽提供表情和动势。少量冷蓝与鲜红色强调增强对比，却不使有限色盘复杂化。主要色块尺度上的边缘清晰，描绘线条仍保留轻微手工变化。光线具有图形性且均匀，阴影被转化为实心深色团块，而非渐进明暗塑形。贴近且裁切的安排将焦点形体推向观看者，让一整片未打断的色域成为强烈负空间。整体效果明亮、直接，富于戏剧性。
theme_en: A dark-haired woman resting her face in both hands against yellow
theme_zh: 黄色背景前以双手托脸的黑发女子
name: Deborah Azzopardi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
